envelope.description: Any JSON value: the broker stays operation-shaped (D12): the envelope is trex's versioned result contract, described by its describe command, and passes through as is.

id.description: The ID of one of several types: an entry is a FeedPost or a Thesis Signal (GraphQL v2 FeedEntry), so its id is the D16 ID of one of the two.

input.description: Any JSON value: the research tool input is Backend's research tool protocol, validated by Backend per tool.

output.description: Any JSON value: the research tool output is Backend's research tool protocol, versioned by schemaVersion.

input.description: Any JSON value: the research tool input is Backend's research tool protocol, validated by Backend per tool.

args.description: Any JSON value: a script's arguments are the script's own JSON object; Backend validates it and the runtime passes it on unparsed.

context.description: Any JSON value: free-form diagnostics an agent attaches to a report; the Backend only checks they are JSON, redacts secret-looking keys and bounds their size, and nothing reads their fields.

evidence.description: Any JSON value: free-form diagnostics an agent attaches to a report; the Backend only checks they are JSON, redacts secret-looking keys and bounds their size, and nothing reads their fields.

post.description: Requires content:write and an admin (403 ADMIN_REQUIRED otherwise).
